description: Saves a Contacts view, as Save view on the Contacts page does: name, visibility (me for only you, team for everyone, people for named teammates), people (team member ids, needed for people), and the table's query and presentation. The view is a saved filter anyone you shared it with can open. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a replay returns the first view.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: save_contact_view
title: Save a Contacts view
